welcome.heroText: Vaccine sales, lot and expiry tracking, debts, cash flow, e-invoices and tax books for every branch.
welcome.featureLotsTitle: Vaccine stock by lot and expiry
welcome.featureLotsText: First-expired, first-out — expired lots can never be sold.
welcome.featureOfflineText: The checkout keeps working and syncs automatically when back online.
welcome.featureTaxText: MISA integration, accounting books and household business tax returns.
welcome.footer: For support, contact your organisation's system administrator.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.recoveryIntro: Store the recovery codes below somewhere safe. Each code can be used once to sign in when you don't have your phone. They are shown only once.
twoFactor.step1: 1. Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator...) on your phone and scan the QR code:
twoFactor.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter the key manually:
twoFactor.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app:
twoFactor.manageIntro: Two-factor authentication is on. Enter your password and a code from the app (or a recovery code) to turn it off or regenerate recovery codes.
